messages.author: d0811d5546410a98
messages.subject: how to get messages from the server with an app hosted on glimer.rstudio.com ?
parts:
Hi,

I've just uploaded a shiny app on glimer.rstudio.com.
How can i get messages from server when the app is launched ?
I don't have any error message, but my app doesn't work as expected. HTML and javascript seems to be ok. 

http://glimmer.rstudio.com/fxi/predictMap/

Thanks !

Frédéric

messages.author: d0811d5546410a98
messages.subject: Re: how to get messages from the server with an app hosted on glimer.rstudio.com ?
parts:
Hello again,

Maybe the answer to my question is too obvious, but i did not find out how to debug my shiny app when it's online.. In local, it works but on glimmer.rstudio.com, it does not work. 
In the logs files (~/ShinyApps/log/), there is no clues about what's wrong. It says only something like 'Listening on port 34028' and then, the file disapear after the app is launched... I got 4 log files left for real errors  (wrong paths after uploading), but now i have no idea why this doesn't work.

Maybe I should rewrite my app without HTML ui... Or look for another ways to share my results. 

I'm a beginner with R/HTML/JS and without a feedback of the server, my app is like as a black box. 

I've tried to launch it via runApp over SSH, but it doesn't not work like this i guess..

If my problem is not clear or too simple, please tell me.

Thanks you !

Frédéric

Thanks.

Frederic
